comment: Each make target of CHECK_TARGETS declares its scope and the setup steps it needs: needs ["databases"] is a target that reads the servers of make orm-test-servers and the bench and decimal databases of the run, which the runner records as not-run, with the failed step and its first failure lines, when the setup steps servers, databases/create or go-lease fail; needs [] runs whatever the setup steps did. The other needs are the tools that the CI setup steps install (scripts/check/ci-setup.mts): go, go-lease, rust, php, php-min, composer, node-modules, interfaces-typescript, parity-symbols, php-extension-tools and server-programs; when such a step fails in CI, the runner records the targets that need it as not-run with that step, and runs every other target. A local run has no CI setup steps. An owner target is a per-file check (format, checklist, documents, the unit tests of a checker): make owner-check runs it when a changed path matches its inputs. A suite target is part of the full suite only: make orm-check runs it once, and make owner-check never selects it; a changed feature's own verification and coverage run in its place. make owner-check and make repo-check fail on a target without a scope, an owner target without inputs, a suite target with inputs, and an input pattern that matches no tracked file. A pattern matches a repository path: * within one path segment, ** across segments.

.claude/settings.json.reason: it registers the Claude Code hooks of @polyspec/kit (claude-hook.mjs) for an agent session; no check or test reads it

.githooks/commit-msg.reason: a git hook of kit: make hooks writes it and make hooks-check compares it with the hook of kit; no test reads it

.githooks/pre-commit.reason: a git hook of kit: make hooks writes it and make hooks-check compares it with the hook of kit; no test reads it

.github/runner.reason: it names the runner image of every job of the CI workflow, so it changes the machine that runs every target

.github/workflows/ci.yml.reason: it defines the CI jobs that install the toolchains and run make orm-check and the documentation checks, so it changes how every target runs in CI

.github/workflows/docs-pages.yml.reason: it builds and publishes the documentation site from every document on each push to main, so it changes the publication of every page

.gitignore.reason: it only decides which files git ignores; no test reads it, and owner-check and make orm-check list changed files through git

.php-version.reason: it selects the PHP release of every check, locally and in CI, so it changes the runtime of every PHP target

LICENSE.reason: license text; no code or test reads it

composer.json.reason: the private Composer root that installs the PHP dependencies every PHP check loads through the autoloader

composer.lock.reason: it pins the PHP dependencies that every PHP check loads through the autoloader

config/knip-entries.json.reason: Knip entry for the constructor fixture passed by the native extractor test; lint configuration, not a behavior test

examples/go.mod.reason: it pins the modules of the Go examples and their output test

examples/go.sum.reason: it pins the module checksums of the Go examples and their output test

go.work.reason: it joins the Go modules packages/go, tests and examples, so every Go build and test resolves the orm packages from the checkout

go.work.sum.reason: it pins the checksums of the modules that the workspace of go.work resolves beyond the go.sum of its modules

mise.toml.reason: its tool node selects the Node release of every check, locally and in CI, so it changes the runtime of every Node and TypeScript target

packages/go/go.mod.reason: it pins the Go toolchain and the modules of every Go build and test

packages/go/go.sum.reason: it pins the module checksums of every Go build and test

packages/go/internal/testdb/testdb.go.reason: every Go database test opens its database through it, so it changes the setup of every Go database target

packages/python/uv.lock.reason: it pins the native uv development environment of the Python client used by its checks

packages/php-ext/testing/dbspec/apply/ph.reason: the dbspec apply runner of the PHP extension client, run by the cross-client runners (tests/dbspec/compare/runners.mts)

packages/php-ext/testing/dbspec/compare/.reason: the dbspec compare runner of the PHP extension client, run by the cross-client runners (tests/dbspec/compare/runners.mts)

packages/php-ext/testing/dbspec/introspe.reason: the dbspec introspect runner of the PHP extension client, run by the cross-client runners (tests/dbspec/compare/runners.mts)

packages/php/testing/dbspec/apply/php.ph.reason: the dbspec apply runner of the PHP client, run by the perf test and the decimal physical check (scripts/perf-test.mts, scripts/decimal-physical-check.mts)

packages/php/testing/dbspec/compare/php-.reason: the interface of the PHP compare runner, loaded by the PHP and PHP extension compare runners (packages/php/testing/dbspec/compare/php.php)

packages/php/testing/dbspec/compare/php..reason: the dbspec compare runner of the PHP client, run by the perf test and the client database test (scripts/perf-test.mts, scripts/client-db-test.mts)

packages/php/testing/dbspec/introspect/p.reason: the dbspec introspect runner of the PHP client, run by the perf test and the client database test (scripts/perf-test.mts, scripts/client-db-test.mts)

packages/php/testing/required_dsn.php.reason: the shared DSN helper of the PHP coverage cases (packages/php/tests/coverage_cases.php), which the PHP library and the PHP extension both run

packages/rust/case-clock/src/lib.rs.reason: every Rust test that checks the database clock takes its case clock from it

packages/rust/case-database/src/lib.rs.reason: every Rust database test creates and drops its case database through it

packages/rust/rustfmt.toml.reason: it configures rustfmt, which rust-fmt-check runs over every Rust file

packages/rust/tests/tests/integration/ma.reason: the crate root of the Rust integration test target: it generates the models and declares the coverage and result-chain modules of every database feature, so it changes which Rust feature cases compile and run

packages/ts/testing/dbspec/apply/typescr.reason: the dbspec apply runner of the TypeScript client, selected by the feature check (scripts/features/check.mts, contracts/features.json)

packages/ts/testing/dbspec/compare/types.reason: the dbspec compare runner of the TypeScript client, selected by the feature check (scripts/features/check.mts, contracts/features.json)

packages/ts/testing/dbspec/introspect/ty.reason: the dbspec introspect runner of the TypeScript client, selected by the feature check (scripts/features/check.mts, contracts/features.json)

packages/ts/tsconfig.bootstrap.json.reason: scripts/typescript/build.mts compiles the generator sources with it before the models exist, so every make target and npm script that builds the TypeScript client reads it

rust-toolchain.toml.reason: it selects the Rust toolchain of every Rust build and test, locally and in CI

scripts/cargo-build-copy.mts.reason: every make target that runs a Rust program builds and copies that program through it (CARGO_COPY)

scripts/ci/php-extension-tools.mts.reason: the CI setup step php-extension-tools runs it to check the phpize and php-config with which the PHP extension polyspec_orm is built, so it gates the PHP extension targets in CI

scripts/ci/server-programs.mts.reason: the CI setup step server-programs runs it to install the programs of the database servers on the Linux runner, so it changes the servers of every database target in CI

scripts/free-ports.mts.reason: make orm-test-servers chooses the ports of the database servers of this checkout through it, so it changes the servers of every database target

scripts/publish-output.mts.reason: every make target that builds the lease program, the process tools, a stress document or a test binary publishes it through it (PUBLISH)

scripts/typescript/build.mts.reason: every make target and npm script that builds the TypeScript client publishes packages/ts/dist through it

tests/go.mod.reason: it pins the modules of the Go runners and physical tests under tests/

tests/go.sum.reason: it pins the module checksums of the Go runners and physical tests under tests/

tests/timezone/date.ini.reason: WITH_TEST_ENV adds it to the PHP ini scan path of every target that runs database clients, so it sets the time zone of every PHP client the suite starts
